inspection_method: synthesis of curated studio portfolio metadata, inspected visible frames, and provisional benchmark annotations; full playback coverage is incomplete

signals.statement: Product surfaces and real product actions should carry the proof when the product mechanism is central.
signals.use: Prefer a readable product state and causal action over a generic dashboard montage.
signals.limits: This does not require raw screen capture in every scene; simplify only when disclosed and faithful.

signals.statement: Contemporary product storytelling controls density by isolating the relevant action or result instead of showing all interface chrome at once.
signals.use: Keep context sufficient for truth, then give the active object a clear hierarchy.
signals.limits: A sparse frame is not automatically modern and may hide required context.

signals.statement: Continuity is strongest when an object, state, or causal relationship persists across scenes.
signals.use: Carry a task, row, cursor, node, or result through adjacent states when that improves comprehension.
signals.limits: Do not imply a causal link that the product does not have.

signals.statement: UI, type, illustration, footage, and 3D can coexist when each medium has a defined communication job.
signals.use: Assign product proof to UI and reserve other media for context, scale, emotion, or abstraction.
signals.limits: The current corpus is too small to claim a universal medium mix or fixed ratio.

non_claims: No fixed percentage of UI makes a storyboard contemporary.
A studio portfolio claim does not prove a visual mechanism caused campaign performance.
A visible thumbnail does not establish motion timing, easing, or transition design.
A fashionable material, gradient, or 3D treatment is not evidence of communication quality.
